role: Digital Marketing Intern & IT Division Intern

story: My first real workplace — and one where I got to sit on both sides of the table. Half of my time went into the **creative** side of marketing; the other half into building the **technical** tools that made that work easier. It was the first time I saw how much smoother a team runs when someone understands both.
bullets: Planned content and prepared email campaigns, helping shape the creative direction and keep our messaging consistent from one campaign to the next.

summary: Promoted from Activist to Pengurus after about a year
story:
HIMSISFO is the Information Systems student association, and it's where I've grown the most outside the classroom. I joined as an Activist and, after about a year, was **promoted to Pengurus** — taking on broader responsibility across **project management**, **public relations**, **event operations**, and the association's day-to-day activities.

The roles below are the ones I've held along the way.

summary: Coordinating 80+ PR members across 4 social media pages
story: I coordinate communication between organizational teams and stakeholders, supporting the delivery of clear and timely information across activities and events — leading a public relations team of **80+ members**. I help manage our public-facing communications and keep every message consistent across **4 different social media pages**.

summary: A two-day gathering for HIMSISFO activists, with a 30+ person committee
story: GERAK is a two-day recreational and gathering event designed to strengthen relationships and engagement among HIMSISFO activists. As Vice Project Manager I supported the planning and execution, coordinating preparations across divisions of **30+ people**, monitoring timelines and deliverables, and helping ensure smooth execution throughout the event.

summary: Strategic input for a national Business & IT competition
story: After running publications for DIG IN the year before, I came back on the other side — as an advisor. I provided strategic input and evaluation for this **national Business & Information Technology competition**, supporting the team in refining concepts, identifying potential challenges, and improving project execution.

summary: A leadership and regeneration program for future Pengurus
story: LDKCP is a leadership and regeneration program preparing HIMSISFO activists to take on organizational roles as future **Pengurus**. As Vice Event Coordinator I coordinated the execution of the program from start to finish.

summary: HIMSISFO's General President election, from campaigning to debate
story: BALON is an organizational political event leading into the selection of HIMSISFO's next General President. As Vice Event Coordinator I coordinated the execution of candidate introduction, campaigning, voting, and debate activities.

summary: 40+ pieces of content and 30k+ views in two months
story: I coordinated publication, content production, and documentation for DIG IN, a Business & Information Technology competition, supporting promotional communication before and throughout the program. Over two months we published **40+ social media pieces** and reached **30k+ viewers**.

summary: Publication, decoration and documentation for HIMSISFO's send-off
story: I coordinated publication, content production, and event documentation for HIMSISFO's Farewell Party & Yearbook — managing promotional materials, decorations, visual content, and documentation throughout the event to support communication and archival needs.

summary: Documenting an international study tour to Shanghai, China
story: IMMERSION took us on an **international study tour to Shanghai, China**. I coordinated publication and documentation for the program, documenting activities and preparing digital content throughout.
I hosted the HIMSISFO Welcoming Party — managing transitions, announcements, audience engagement, and overall program flow for **400+ participants**.

summary: Community engagement, bringing IS knowledge to a school in need
story: PkM is a community engagement program that brought Information Systems knowledge to a school in need. As Logistics Staff I supported the preparation and delivery of its educational activities.

story: A team where ideas get taken all the way to execution — from research and problem analysis to building the solution and delivering it. I've worked on projects like **SISCARD Games**, and I'm currently co-writing a **research paper**.
